mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries removes the injectivity constraint on AuditEntry.forOperation. The injection forces two distinct AuditEntry atoms to share the same forOperation, which represents an overwrite of an audit record — exactly the scenario FR-010 and AppendOnly are intended to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.forOperation = ae2.forOperation }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_CareTeamGating removes the requirement that a Permitted outcome implies an active CareTeamMembership. The injection forces a Permitted operation with no active membership, directly violating FR-006 (care-team-only access rule).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = PostRecordsLookup and op.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = op.caller and m.patient = op.targetPatient and m.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AlwaysOnAudit removes the guarantee that every Operation has an AuditEntry. The injection places an Operation with no corresponding AuditEntry, directly violating FR-008 always-on audit and SC-001 (100% of accesses audited).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AlwaysOnAuditViolation { some op: Operation | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.forOperation = op }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AttributionCorrectness removes the snapshot-role consistency rule. The injection forces an AuditEntry whose snapshotRole differs from the actual caller's role, violating FR-009's requirement that the role is faithfully snapshotted at the time of access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.snapshotRole != ae.forOperation.caller.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_ByteEquivalentDenied removes the constraint that Denied outcomes map to DeniedOrNotFoundResponse. The injection forces a Denied-outcome operation to produce a PermittedResponse, leaking the distinction between 'patient exists but caller not on team' and 'patient not found', violating FR-007 and SC-003.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ByteEquivViolation { some r: OperationResponse | r.forOp.outcome = Denied and r.respClass = PermittedResponse }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing F_AuditIGOnly removes the constraint that only AuditOfficer may invoke PostAuditSearch. The injection places a Doctor-role caller on a PostAuditSearch operation, violating FR-011 (IG-only audit access) and SC-011 (audit endpoint existence must not leak to clinical roles).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditIGOnlyViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = PostAuditSearch and op.caller.role = Doctor }
